create_calibration_dataset: create a calibration dataset using get_dataset with a tokenizer, sequence length, and number of samples
configure_quantization_recipe: configure an AutoRoundModifier quantization recipe targeting Linear layers with NVFP4 scheme
run_quantization_oneshot: run oneshot quantization on a model using a calibration dataset and AutoRoundModifier recipe
prepare_model_for_generation: prepare a quantized model for text generation using dispatch_for_generation
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and processor to disk in compressed-tensors format
